title: Chrome vs Firefox
shortAnswer: Chrome dominates with 65% browser market share and best-in-class extension ecosystem. Firefox offers superior privacy, lower memory usage, and is backed by the non-profit Mozilla Foundation focused on internet freedom.
verdict: Chrome for compatibility and extensions. Firefox for privacy and resource efficiency. Both are excellent browsers.
